routes.label: Eliminate y and factor in x

audits.mathematicalReason: Substituting y = x²-a gives x²[x²+1-2a] = 0. The root x = 0 always supplies (0,-a). Exactly two further distinct real roots occur when 2a-1 > 0, namely x = ±√(2a-1), so exactly three intersections require a > 1/2. At a = 1/2 the roots coincide, leaving only one point. Alternatively, eliminating x² gives y = -a or a-1, followed by the same feasibility check. Counting distinct real zeros after elimination supports cnm_h049; both algebraic routes respect branches and multiplicity.
